verifications.claim: Thousands of users recently reported issues with the eBay app and website, according to Hindustantimes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Thousands of users... reporting that the search function on their eBay app and website is not working... More than 4,000 users have reported... 23% said they encountered issues with the app, while 17% complained that the website malfunctioned.' R2: 'thousands of eBay users complained... more than 4,300 users... 23% had problems with mobile applications and 17% had problems with the websites.' R10: '38 user-submitted reports of outages in the past 24 hours... Top reported issues: App not loading 10...'
verifications.reasoning: R5 (Hindustan Times) directly states thousands (4,000+) reported issues with app and website; R2 and R10 corroborate recent widespread reports.

verifications.claim: Common issues reported in March 2026 include search functionality where a major issue currently affecting users is the search bar failing to return results.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'thousands... complained about the failure of the search feature... does not allow the shopper to search through the listings... 59% reported that the search feature did not work.' R5: '59% of the users said that the search function was not working.' R10: 'March 26, 2026... Cannot search listings saying server is down... Search results and pages not loading (Mar 23, 2026).'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm search issues (failing to return results) as major problem in March 2026, with specific percentages and recent reports.

verifications.claim: Common issues reported in March 2026 include app errors such as "Server Unavailable" or blank screens.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R10: 'March 26, 2026... Server not responding 4... App not loading 10... Recent outage reports: "La page me marque serveur non disponible" (server unavailable), "Froze up", "Server unavailable" (multiple March dates like Mar 25, 24, 23).'
verifications.reasoning: R10 explicitly lists 'Server Unavailable'/'server not responding' and 'App not loading' (blank/frozen screens) as top issues with March 2026 timestamps.

verifications.claim: Common issues reported in March 2026 include login issues such as problems with verification or loading pages.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R10: 'March 26, 2026... Sign in problem... App not loading and login issues (Feb 25, but recent reports include Sign in problem Mar 26).' R8: 'Ebay login verification has stopped working.'
verifications.reasoning: R10 reports 'Sign in problem' and login issues in March 2026 context; R8 details verification problems, supporting examples of login/loading issues.
